-- 初回 (table 空): created_at_min を遥か昔に → 全件 backfill
-- 以降: 最新 review_created_at の 7日前から (overlap で moderation 状態変化等を拾う)
SELECT IFNULL(FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', TIMESTAMP_SUB(MAX(review_created_at), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS created_at_min FROM `campwill-ec.raw.ec_judgeme_reviews`
